content.user_title: Improve Content Visibility in AI Search
content.value_statement: AI search engines may overlook useful content when its answers, evidence, and structure are difficult to extract. This skill audits visibility and recommends focused improvements.
actual_capabilities: Audits content across structure, authority, and third-party presence.
Evaluates citation visibility across major AI search platforms.
Reviews answer blocks, headings, tables, FAQs, and source attribution.
Checks robots.txt guidance for common AI crawlers.
Recommends content formats and monitoring metrics for priority queries.
Explains differences between citations, mentions, and recommendations.
limitations: Cannot guarantee citations, rankings, mentions, or recommendations.
Needs current pages, target queries, or visibility observations for a specific audit.
Does not replace a technical SEO audit or structured data implementation.
Platform behavior and crawler policies can change after the reference guidance was written.

use_cases.title: Audit SaaS AI visibility
use_cases.description: Find content, authority, and crawlability gaps that may reduce citations across major AI search platforms.

use_cases.title: Improve editorial extractability
use_cases.description: Restructure articles with direct answers, sourced evidence, comparison tables, and useful question headings.

use_cases.title: Plan measurable AI search work
use_cases.description: Prioritize queries, platforms, content updates, and recurring visibility checks within an SEO program.

prompt_templates.title: Review one page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for AI search readiness: [page content or URL details]. Identify the three highest-priority improvements and explain each recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants focused feedback on one page.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitor citations
prompt_templates.prompt: Our brand is [brand], and competitors [names] appear for [queries]. Compare likely structure, authority, and presence gaps using these observations: [details].
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer wants to understand why competitors receive citations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a content optimization plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an AI search optimization plan for [site]. Use our priority queries, content inventory, audience, and current visibility data: [details].
prompt_templates.scenario: A content team needs a prioritized roadmap.

prompt_templates.title: Design a multi-platform audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a detailed audit for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Include evidence requirements, scoring criteria, and monthly monitoring.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced SEO team needs a repeatable audit framework.

output_examples.input: Assess a product page that hides pricing and has no direct category definition.
output: Priority 1: Add a clear category definition near the page opening.
Priority 2: Publish accessible, current pricing and plan limits.
Priority 3: Add sourced proof and answer common buyer questions.

output_examples.input: Explain why our guides receive citations but our product is not recommended.
output_examples.output: Your guides may be useful sources while broader web consensus still favors established products. Strengthen reviews, community discussion, analyst coverage, and earned media.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly AI visibility measurement plan for twenty priority queries.
output: Record citations, mentions, recommendation framing, cited pages, and competitors for each query.
Repeat the same query set across selected platforms each month.
Compare visibility changes with content releases, branded search, and self-reported attribution.

best_practices: Provide priority queries, audience details, current pages, and observed AI answers.
Verify every statistic, quote, product fact, and platform claim before publication.
Measure citations, recommendation framing, and business outcomes over consistent time intervals.
anti_patterns: Do not publish thin AI-targeted pages that offer no value to human readers.
Do not fabricate reviews, citations, expert quotes, or community discussions.
Do not treat a citation as proof that an AI system recommends the brand.

faq.question: What is AI SEO?
faq.answer: AI SEO improves how search assistants discover, understand, extract, cite, and describe web content.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill address?
faq.answer: It covers Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee an AI citation?
faq.answer: No. Citations depend on platform indexes, query context, content quality, authority, freshness, and competing sources.

faq.question: Can it perform a traditional technical SEO audit?
faq.answer: No. Use a technical SEO audit for crawling, indexing, performance, rendering, and broader on-page issues.

faq.question: Does every site need llms.txt or an OKF bundle?
faq.answer: No. These files may help some non-Google systems, but clear public content and established SEO foundations remain more important.

faq.question: What information improves the audit?
faq.answer: Provide target queries, page content, competitors, current citations, robots.txt rules, structured data, and recent performance observations.
